title: Read this boot without changing it
goal: Use scoped boot evidence and distinguish target configuration from health.
challenge: Retain the running kernel command line, default target and a bounded current-boot event excerpt. Explain the boot sequence and what this evidence does not prove. Do not alter boot configuration.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-3; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Create a fresh private workspace; stop on collision or insufficient space.
steps.expected: Exact learner path, no existing entry, at least64MiB free.

steps.command: guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-3 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-3 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
steps.expected: No path substitution; guest root can override guest safeguards.

steps.command: unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
steps.explanation: Retain unrelated package and learner/sudo evidence before any transaction.
steps.expected: Protected unrelated state captured; stop on mismatch.

steps.command: guard && { cat /proc/cmdline; systemctl get-default; systemctl is-system-running; } > boot.txt; cat boot.txt
steps.explanation: The default target is configuration, not a guarantee all units are healthy. Check each status.
steps.expected: Kernel command line, target and actual health text; degraded is evidence to interpret, not a fixed failure.

steps.command: guard && sudo journalctl -b -k -n 10 --no-pager > kernel-log.txt && cat kernel-log.txt
steps.explanation: -b limits this observation to the current boot; guest sudo permits restricted log access.
steps.expected: Ten or fewer kernel journal entries, with boot context.

steps.command: guard && sudo dmesg | head -n 8 > early.txt && cat early.txt
steps.explanation: The ring buffer and journal are different views; one warning does not establish root cause.
steps.expected: Early kernel observations to relate BIOS, loader, kernel and systemd stages.

hints: The target name is not a success verdict.
Explain uncertainty rather than diagnosing from one line.
review: Current-boot scope, target/health distinction, stages and limitations.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 101.2 partial boot logs; 101.3/LPIC-2 202.1 reinforcement only. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
